values.meaning: Time Phase takes to switch main and off-hand weapons
values.quote: '''Aphelios''' switches between his {{as|main weapon}} and {{as|off-hand}} weapon over {{fd|0.25}} seconds
values.binNote: The sheet's ApheliosW spell only carries a cooldown of 0.8; 0.25 does not appear among its data.

mechanics.claim: Toggling Phase does not count as an ability activation for on-cast item/rune effects such as Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: Casting/toggling Phase does not interrupt any attack or ability command issued before or during it.
mechanics.quote: Switching does not interrupt '''any''' commands '''Aphelios''' was issued before or during ''Phase''.
